summary:
Implemented the show_speed feature in rich/progress.py, CHANGELOG.md, and tests/test_progress.py, as specified. Nothing was run and nothing was committed, per your instructions, so the new test and the existing suite are unverified. Running pytest tests/test_progress.py will confirm them.

Changes:
- TaskProgressColumn: new show_speed keyword (default False), a static render_speed(speed) method that scales via filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix, and a render override that shows speed for unknown totals when show_speed is on. Speed source is finished_speed if not None, otherwise speed.
- track(): new last parameter show_speed (default True), documented and passed to TaskProgressColumn.
- Progress.track: unknown total for non-Sized sequences instead of raising ValueError.
- CHANGELOG.md: entry under Unreleased / Added.
- tests: added test_task_progress_column_speed; removed the two ValueError assertions for track(5) and progress.track(5).
